# Executive Summary
Brief synthesis of the main insights and findings derived from the analysis.
Key Takeaway 1: Main observation or business finding.
Key Takeaway 2: Critical metric or pattern identified.
Recommendation: Suggested next action based on data.

# Key Performance Indicators
```{r}
#| label: kpi-summary

# Compute core aggregated metrics
metrics <- df_clean %>% 
  summarise(
    total_obs = n(),
    avg_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_value = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_value = min(value, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Display formatted KPI summary
metrics %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Total Observations", "Average Value", "Max Value", "Min Value"),
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Summary Metrics Overview"
  )
```

# Analytical Findings
## Key Distribution & Trends
```{r}
#| label: plot-main-finding
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5

df_clean %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = id, y = value)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#e74c3c", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Value Distribution Across Sample",
    subtitle = "Analysis based on processed pipeline data",
    x = "Observation ID",
    y = "Value"
  )
```

# Summary Data Table
```{r}
#| label: data-table

# Display detailed results table
df_clean %>% 
  head(10) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    caption = "First 10 Observations of the Analysis Dataset"
  )
```
